messages:
Maria Chen: Heads up — want to align on a Grafana + Prometheus healthscore for GPUs across regions. Seeing a bump in ECC/Xid errors in eu-west over the last 48h. Thinking: single 'gpu-region-health' dashboard, per-region score (0-100), SLO 99.5% for hosted, separate tiers for Dedicated/private, alert when score < 90 for >15m. Thoughts?

Jason Patel: +1 on a unified score. Can we make the SLO tied to user-facing latency/fallbacks rather than raw ECC counts? Replacing cards has cost/lead-time.

Khaled Omar: I dug into the node logs — it's mostly Xid 13/31 across a subset of cards. Sample kernel snippet: 
```text
kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13, GPU has fallen off the bus
nvidia: ECC error - corrected: 12 uncorrected: 2
```
Suggest panels: per-card Xid rate, corrected ECC rate, uncorrected ECC rate, GPU temperature histogram, pod drain count, per-node recent reboots. Recommend health score formula (start simple):
```
health = 100 - clamp( (0.6 * norm_xid_rate) + (0.3 * norm_uncorrected_ecc) + (0.1 * temp_anomaly), 0, 100 )
```
Where norm_* are normalized to 0-100 using recent 90th percentile baselines.

Anita Singh: Caveat: driver/OS noisy counters cause spikes — smooth with a 5m rolling avg and require sustained signal (>=15m) before paging. Also require >=3 affected cards in a rack to mark replacement candidate, otherwise it's a remediation (reboot/drain). Propose canary drain policy snippet: 
```bash
# safe drain example
kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300
# then cordon and mark for replacement
kubectl cordon gpu-node-42
kubectl label node gpu-node-42 gpu-failed=true
```
Add to SOP: try soft-reboot, reflash driver if repeated Xid, then escalate to replace if uncorrected ECC exceeds threshold.

Lee Carter: +devex: dashboard should have a quick action link to the SOP and a button that opens a pre-filled runbook issue. Also add a per-tenant impact overlay (percent of requests routed to fallback models / latency degradation) so product can estimate cost/SLI impact.

Jason Patel: On SLO levels — 99.9% is ambitious for some regions. Proposal: Hosted API clusters = 99.5 baseline, Dedicated = 99.9 / 99.95 depending on commit. Keep separate SLOs per deployment class.

Khaled Omar: Draft Prometheus alert rule to start discussion: 
```yaml
- alert: GPUHealthScoreLow
  expr: gpu_region_health_score{region=\"eu-west\"} < 90
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: \"GPU health score below 90 in eu-west\"
```
I'll add a Grafana panel with sparklines, per-node map, and a list of flagged nodes. I'll also backfill the score for 3 months to tune the clamp/weights.

sre-bot: [automated] Alert fingerprint: a1b2 - 12 Xid errors on 3 nodes in eu-west-2 in last 30m. Created incident #INC-2026-117.

Maria Chen: Thanks — next steps: Khaled to iterate dashboard PR and include backfill, Anita to draft drain + replacement SOP with decision rules, Lee to add runbook links and per-tenant overlay, Jason to sign off on SLO tiers by EOD Thu. I'll schedule a 30m sync Fri 9am PT. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Khaled Omar: I'll open the dashboard PR and include simulated healthscore backfill for the last 3 months so thresholds can be tuned without causing noise.

Anita Singh: Will start drafting the SOP. Early decision rule: mark for replacement if uncorrected_ecc_rate > 0.5% AND Xid spikes > 10/hr for 2 consecutive days, otherwise prefer drain + requeue.

Maria Chen: Perfect — leaving notes in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/gpu-healthscore (internal) :white_check_mark:
